body: Great! Will check again once it makes it into a release and report back.

I believe I'm also having the same issue with a large project. The entire editor freezes.

I'm quite certain the root cause is the same, but the symptoms are different before and after 599f2bd.

Then please update the details in the original report to be up to date (including the version) or open a separate report if the issue is not the same (it seems this is no longer a crash, which is pretty critical)

Issues should be tracked based on *symptoms* not underlying causes unless they are the same (in this case it's not likely as the issue has changed behavior significantly, from a crash to a deadlock, and following changes to code)

The fix for #118824 fixes this issue but another (seemingly independent) part of that change introduces the deadlock. Based on the discussion in the core rocket chat that change is likely to be reverted, so this issue will remain relevant, while the deadlock is clearly being tracked by the relevant core devs. I have also shared my project and reported my findings on that issue's thread.

Then this should be kept as is, closed for now awaiting a possible revert, and a new issue should be opened for the regression from that change I'd say, as this bug is fixed (and if that PR doesn't get reverted this should be closed)

Closing, as the original issue has been addressed; will reopen if a revert occurs. I would absolutely encourage making a separate issue for the new behavior you've noticed, as it'd be worthwhile to track in isolation
@Repiteo  Do we have tests for this ? it would make sense if there is a test for this case as one can affect other (lets not run in circle )
